chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Satan remains fearful of the believer as long as he maintains the five prayers; but when he neglects them, Satan becomes bold over him and causes him to fall into major sins.
ai.seo_question: How does neglecting the five daily prayers affect a believer's relationship with Satan?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the spiritual efficacy of the five daily prayers as a shield against Satan, a concept central to Shia devotional practice. It establishes a direct causal link between ritual consistency and spiritual resilience, warning that neglecting Salah emboldens the devil to lead the believer into major transgressions. This teaching underscores the practical role of Salah not merely as worship, but as a continuous state of divine protection.
